verdict.rationale: dLocal's own get-started docs name the three marketplace elements in one line: automated onboarding, split payments and settlements. Separate lines mention mass payouts and paying partners. These are one-line overview claims with no detail on how a platform registers sellers, configures splits per transaction, or routes payouts to each seller, so only a thin version of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: seller/sub-merchant onboarding API docs, split-payment configuration details, per-seller payout routing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Automated onboarding, split payments, and settlements.
Mass payouts, multi-currency support, and compliance with local regulations.
Pay your staff, customers, and partners in the currency of their choice.
